name: mdocx-converter
description: Export Markdown files to DOCX with Pandoc, Mermaid diagrams, bundled reference templates, and document profiles.

mdocxConverter.mermaidCliPath.description: Path to the Mermaid CLI executable (mmdc). Required only when the Markdown file contains mermaid code fences.

mdocxConverter.referenceDocx.description: Optional path to a reference DOCX template. If empty, the extension will first look for reference.docx next to the Markdown file, then use the bundled template selected by mdocxConverter.referenceLanguage.

enumDescriptions: Automatically detect Markdown language: choose Chinese template when Chinese content is dominant, otherwise English.
Use the bundled English reference DOCX.
Use the bundled Chinese reference DOCX.
mdocxConverter.referenceLanguage.description: Bundled reference DOCX language used when mdocxConverter.referenceDocx is empty and no local reference.docx exists next to the Markdown file.

mdocxConverter.outputDirectory.description: Optional output directory for exported DOCX files. Relative paths are resolved from the Markdown file folder.

mdocxConverter.mermaidOutputFormat.description: Rendered image format for mermaid diagrams before conversion.

enumDescriptions: Render with the local Mermaid CLI first and fall back to the Mermaid Ink API when mmdc is unavailable.
Render with the local Mermaid CLI only. Export fails with install guidance when mmdc is missing.
Render with the Mermaid Ink HTTP API only. Diagram content is sent to the configured host.
mdocxConverter.mermaidRenderer.description: How Mermaid diagrams are rendered. The API fallback sends diagram content to mermaid.ink unless a self-hosted Mermaid Ink URL is configured.

mdocxConverter.mermaidApiUrl.description: Base URL of the Mermaid Ink service used when mdocxConverter.mermaidRenderer allows the API fallback. Point this at a self-hosted instance to keep diagram content local.

mdocxConverter.documentTitle.description: Document title written into the DOCX core properties. Leave empty to use the first heading in the document, or the file name when the document has no heading.

mdocxConverter.openAfterExport.description: After export, open the generated DOCX location. On Windows, the file is selected in Explorer to avoid shell association pop-up failures.

mdocxConverter.keepIntermediateFiles.description: Keep temporary markdown and rendered mermaid assets for debugging.

enumDescriptions: Template only: use the selected reference DOCX without extra metadata overrides.
Academic paper: 12 pt, 1.5 line spacing, Times New Roman/SimSun body with SimHei headings.
Business report: 11 pt, 1.5 line spacing, Arial body with Microsoft YaHei headings.
Technical document: 11 pt, 1.35 line spacing, Arial body text, and Consolas-oriented code styles.
Official document (GB/T 9704): 16 pt Times New Roman/FangSong body, SimHei/KaiTi/FangSong headings, fixed 29 pt line spacing.
Thesis (GB/T 7713): 12 pt Times New Roman/SimSun body, SimHei headings from 22 pt down, 1.5 line spacing.
mdocxConverter.styleProfile.description: Optional FlexMD-style document preset layered on top of the selected reference DOCX.

mdocxConverter.bodyFont.description: Optional body font metadata override, for example SimSun, Microsoft YaHei, Times New Roman, or Arial.

mdocxConverter.bodySizePt.description: Optional body font size in points. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.heading1SizePt.description: Optional Heading 1 font size in points. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.heading2SizePt.description: Optional Heading 2 font size in points. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.heading3SizePt.description: Optional Heading 3 font size in points. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.lineSpacing.description: Optional line spacing multiplier from 0.5 to 4, for example 1, 1.25, or 1.5. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.marginTopMm.description: Optional top margin from 1 to 50 millimeters. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.marginBottomMm.description: Optional bottom margin from 1 to 50 millimeters. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.marginLeftMm.description: Optional left margin from 1 to 50 millimeters. Set 0 to use the template/default.

mdocxConverter.marginRightMm.description: Optional right margin from 1 to 50 millimeters. Set 0 to use the template/default.
